limitations: This is an agent review of sampled decoded images, not uninterrupted full-video playback. It cannot establish every transition or motion frame.
No human listened to the audio. Audio quality/synchronization perceptual acceptance is not claimed; technical AAC/decode/non-silence checks belong to verification report.
Only3 active-caption samples were visually inspected; full cue timing was validated technically and all narration words were not visually re-read.
Projected actor/furniture picking and shared fixture aliases remain the documented game limitations. Social outcomes are decided by the simulation, not guaranteed by the walkthrough.
